title: Study on the discharge behavior of spent lithium-ion batteries under externally assisted conditions
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2410-2420
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00084J, Paper
Qiao Yu, Rao Zhonghao
In this paper, the effects of solution type, concentration and external conditions on the discharge behavior of spent LIBs are investigated. The results show that agitation and ultrasound can reduce the discharge time by 40% and 60%, respectively.
